explanations.18: position: relative here makes the terminal container a reference point so child elements can use absolute positioning (like the copy button) relative to it instead of the whole page.
explanations.44: flex-shrink: 0 prevents the icon from getting squished when there's not much horizontal space — it forces the icon to keep its full 16px width.
explanations.82: white-space: pre-wrap means line breaks and spaces in the code are preserved, and long lines wrap to the next line instead of disappearing off the screen.
explanations.83: word-break: break-all will split long words or file paths mid-word if needed to fit them on the screen, rather than letting them overflow horizontally.
explanations.111: min-width: 0 is a trick that lets flex containers shrink their children below the content's natural width; without it, the content width acts as a minimum.
explanations.154: fill: currentcolor makes the SVG icon inherit the text color from its parent, so it changes color automatically if the parent's color property changes.
explanations.169: The animation overlay uses inset: 0 to stretch itself to fill its parent's entire content area (top, right, bottom, left all 0).
explanations.174: padding: inherit copies the padding from the parent element, so the overlay's text lines up pixel-perfectly with the ghost content beneath it.
explanations.195: step-end makes the cursor change instantly at each frame of the blink animation rather than smoothly fading, creating a classic typewriter effect.
explanations.201: :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6) is a CSS selector that matches any of those heading elements; this rule resets all heading styles to normal text size so they don't look like chapter titles.
